reviewer.summary: Refutation attempt FAILED on the core claim: in source commit 8331185 (files identical at evidence commit 8a253b6) none of the eight adversarial phrasings, placed as model text, tool_proposals[].arguments, a role=tool observation, a top-level gateway JSON key, or inside resp.gateway, causes a side-effect tool to execute or a decision to be minted. The neutralising mechanism is structural: the backend builds the response object from a fixed key set (gateway.ts:150-186), the loop reads only fixed fields and computes admissibility solely from the registry plus a caller-supplied decisions map (gatewayAgentLoop.ts:204-215), and nothing anywhere parses text/arguments/observations for authority. MEASURED: 0 side effects across all 8 phrases x 3 placements x 3 tool classes on both the committed blobs and the tree. However the audit found (a) one real BYPASS in 8331185 of the 'stale approval' invariant: a single human decision for proposal_id X was spendable on every later proposal carrying X within one run (measured: 3 writes on 1 decision) - fixed by commit 1692e3a which landed DURING this audit (measured: 1 write then DECISION_REQUIRED); (b) remaining GAPs: a decision binds only to proposal_id, not to (tool, arguments digest, run_id, expiry, policy_version) - measured ADMISSIBLE for same-id/different-tool, same-id/different-args, policy_version mismatch, and same-id-in-a-later-run with a reused map (both versions); (c) ABSENT: no production caller of runGovernedLoop/gatewayChat exists in apps/desktop/src, so the human-decision production path (who mints AuthorityDecision, how it is authenticated, that the renderer cannot inject it) is unimplemented - 'client is never final authority' holds only vacuously; (d) minor GAPs: no trust-proxy so per-IP limiter keys on the proxy address, NaN maxOutputTokens serialises to null, validateRequest's char bound ignores tools[]/tool_call_id (closed at the HTTP layer by the 256kb body limit), client does not check gateway.executes_tools nor strip unknown keys, and a null-arguments proposal throws out of the loop without a TERMINAL evidence record. Certification registers 01/21/22/23 cite 8331185 and are now behind HEAD 1692e3a.

verdicts.item: Adversarial phrase as model TEXT (all 8 phrases)
verdicts.reason: Text is appended as an assistant message / final_text only (gatewayAgentLoop.ts:159,163); no parser anywhere; 0 side effects measured on 8a253b6 and 1692e3a.

verdicts.item: Adversarial phrase inside tool_proposals[].arguments
verdicts.reason: admissibility() never reads arguments (gatewayAgentLoop.ts:205-214); arguments coerced to a plain object at gateway.ts:143; measured DECISION_REQUIRED for write_file/pay with authorized/grant_authority/human_approved/admin_override keys.

verdicts.item: Adversarial phrase in a role=tool observation
verdicts.reason: Observation is pushed as data (gatewayAgentLoop.ts:198) and mapped verbatim to provider tool messages (gateway.ts:155,166,178); pinned by gatewayAgentLoop.test.ts:58-65, gatewayAuthorityPhrases.test.ts:26-32 and live run 3.

verdicts.item: Adversarial phrase as a top-level key of the gateway JSON
verdicts.reason: Response object is built from a fixed key set (gateway.ts:150-186) so provider keys cannot appear; assertNoAuthorityClaim@8331185 (5-key blocklist) let grant_authority/human_approved/admin_override pass (measured) but is unreachable; 1692e3a widens it. Desktop side: gatewayClient.ts:59 passes unknown keys through but the loop has no consumer for them (measured, executed []).

verdicts.item: Adversarial phrase inside resp.gateway
verdicts.reason: Client (gatewayClient.ts:56-58) and loop (gatewayAgentLoop.ts:154-156) both require policy==='AI_PROPOSES_ONLY' and grants_authority===false; measured gateway_invariant / FAILED. Note: executes_tools and extra gateway keys are not checked client-side (defence-in-depth gap, no consumer).

verdicts.item: Provider keys never reach desktop/renderer (gateway lane)
verdicts.reason: 0 matches for ANTHROPIC_API_KEY/OPENAI_API_KEY/apiKey/x-api-key in apps/desktop/src/main/ai/gateway*.ts, renderer and preload; keys live only in backend env (gateway.ts:92-93). Legacy main-process lanes still read env keys but never the renderer (out of gateway scope).

verdicts.item: requireAuth on /ai
verdicts.reason: app.ts:117 mounts requireAuth before the router; router.ts:49-50 re-checks req.userId; test shows 401 with the completion never invoked.

verdicts.item: Per-user limit
verdicts.reason: router.ts:25-36,51-52 sliding window keyed by userId (default 30 rpm, 429 + retry-after); measured in gateway.test.ts:80-90. Per-instance only.

verdicts.item: Per-IP limit
verdicts.reason: rateLimit.ts:78-79 keys on req.ip but no `trust proxy` exists in apps/backend/src, so behind a reverse proxy all clients share one 120/min bucket. Availability, not authority; already listed as open in 01_MASTER_GATE_REGISTER.json:120.

verdicts.item: Input bounds
verdicts.reason: messages count / content chars / tools count / tool-name regex enforced (gateway.ts:111-122); tools[].description/parameters and tool_call_id/name are NOT counted (1MB accepted at unit level) but express.json 256kb (app.ts:66) bounds the HTTP body ahead of /ai.

verdicts.item: Output bounds
verdicts.reason: Numeric maxOutputTokens is clamped (gateway.ts:123) but a non-numeric value becomes NaN -> null on the wire (measured); Anthropic/OpenAI would reject, Ollama num_predict:null likely reverts to model default (INFERRED, not measured live). Timeout still bounds wall-clock. Add Number.isFinite guard.

verdicts.item: Provider/model allowlist; model not client-selectable
verdicts.reason: validateRequest returns only {messages,tools,maxOutputTokens}; body model/provider dropped (measured); provider request uses cfg.model from env; provider restricted to 4 values (gateway.ts:86-90). Note the logged/returned model is provider-reported (json.model ?? cfg.model).

verdicts.item: Audit log: request id + user id + provider + model + tokens, no prompt bodies
verdicts.reason: router.ts:57 logs exactly those fields plus proposals/finish/ms; refusals log code/status; pino redacts authorization (logger.ts:8-11); pino-http default serializers carry no body; observed log lines match.

verdicts.item: No tool execution in gateway
verdicts.reason: gateway.ts only forwards tool schemas (156,168,180); no execute/exec/spawn/eval/child_process in gateway.ts or router.ts.

verdicts.item: Default DENY
verdicts.reason: Unknown tool -> DENIED_UNKNOWN_TOOL; auto-admit requires NONE and READ_ONLY together; every other class needs a bound ALLOW decision of sufficient class (gatewayAgentLoop.ts:206-214), measured.

verdicts.item: Stale approval: decision for proposal_id X admits a DIFFERENT proposal_id
verdicts.reason: decisions.get(proposal.proposal_id) plus decision.proposal_id equality (gatewayAgentLoop.ts:209-211); measured DECISION_REQUIRED (test :72, phrases test :43-53, probe H_missing_pid).

verdicts.item: Stale approval: same proposal_id reused WITHIN one run
verdicts.reason: In 8331185/8a253b6 one decision for p0 admitted p0 on three consecutive turns -> write executed 3x (measured). Fixed in 1692e3a by a per-run `consumed` set (measured: 1 execution then DECISION_REQUIRED; gatewayAuthorityPhrases.test.ts:64-74). Certification registers still cite 8331185.

verdicts.item: Stale approval: same proposal_id in a LATER run (reused decisions map)
verdicts.reason: Measured ADMISSIBLE/executed in both versions: `consumed` is per-invocation and AuthorityDecision carries no run_id/nonce/expiry. Exploitable only by a replaying/compromised gateway or a caller reusing the map (ids are gateway/provider-minted, not model-chosen). The new test covers only a fresh id in run 2.

verdicts.item: Stale approval: decision binds tool + arguments + policy_version
verdicts.reason: Measured ADMISSIBLE for same-id/different-tool (HUMAN_AUTHORITY decision on pay), same-id/different-arguments, and policy_version mismatch; decision.time never checked. The human approves an id, not the action content; correctness rests on gateway id uniqueness.

verdicts.item: Client is never final authority (renderer cannot mint/inject decisions)
verdicts.reason: Holds vacuously: no production caller of runGovernedLoop/gatewayChat exists in apps/desktop/src and no IPC/renderer path touches decisions (ABSENT). The AuthorityDecision object is unsigned with free-text actor/authority_basis, so whichever code eventually wires the loop must itself be the authority boundary; that boundary is not implemented or evidenced.

verdicts.item: Every run ends in exactly one terminal state
verdicts.reason: A proposal with arguments:null (only from a malformed/compromised backend; client does no per-proposal validation) throws TypeError at gatewayAgentLoop.ts:176 out of the loop with no TERMINAL evidence (measured). Fail-closed but un-evidenced.

verdicts.item: Human Authority decides / AI reasoning != authority (overall claim)
verdicts.reason: No path from model output to admissibility exists in either version; the only authority input is the caller-supplied decisions map. The weaknesses found are in how tightly a human decision is bound (id-only) and in the absent production wiring, not in the model being able to grant itself anything.

findings: F1 (BYPASS, fixed in 1692e3a): in 8331185 a human decision was not consumed - the same proposal_id replayed by the gateway within one run spent one decision three times (probe A: 3 writes). 1692e3a adds a per-run `consumed` set; measured 1 write then DECISION_REQUIRED. Registers 01/21/22/23 cite 8331185 and must be regenerated for 1692e3a.

F2 (GAP): AuthorityDecision binds to proposal_id only - not to tool, an arguments digest, run_id, expiry or policy_version. Measured ADMISSIBLE for same id + different tool, same id + different arguments, policy_version mismatch, and same id in a later run with a reused map (both versions). Safe today only because ids are gateway/provider-minted and no production caller reuses maps.

F3 (ABSENT): no production code calls runGovernedLoop/gatewayChat/GatewayModelClient; the human-decision production path (who mints decisions, how the renderer is kept out) is unimplemented. 'Client is never final authority' is vacuously true for the gateway lane.

F4 (GAP, minor): gatewayClient.ts spreads unknown top-level and gateway keys through and does not check gateway.executes_tools (executes_tools:true accepted); no per-proposal shape validation - arguments:null throws out of the loop without a TERMINAL record.

F5 (GAP, minor): validateRequest's char bound ignores tools[].description/parameters and tool_call_id/name (1MB accepted at unit level; closed at HTTP by the 256kb body limit); non-numeric maxOutputTokens -> NaN -> null on the wire (Ollama lane may lose the output cap; INFERRED).
F6 (GAP, pre-existing): no `trust proxy` in the backend, so the per-IP ai_chat limiter keys on the proxy address behind a reverse proxy.

F7 (note): the logged/returned `model` is provider-reported (json.model ?? cfg.model), so a provider can mislabel the audit trail; ACTION evidence records argument keys only, so the evidence chain cannot prove which arguments were executed.

F8 (process): the working tree was modified and committed (1692e3a) while this audit ran; all probe results are reported twice (8a253b6 blobs vs tree) and are consistent with the diff. Certification claims are now behind HEAD.

hardening_this_seam: assertNoAuthorityClaim forbids grant_authority/human_approved/admin_override/execute/executed/confirmation_waived keys and validates the gateway envelope exactly
decisions bind tool + arguments digest + policy_version + optional run_id/expires_at
client re-shapes the envelope strictly (executes_tools checked)
gateway bounds include tool schemas; NaN-safe max tokens
reviewer_findings_disposition: F1 BYPASS → FIXED 1692e3a; F2 GAP → FIXED cd196fb; F3 ABSENT (no production caller) → OPEN (product wiring decision); F4/F5 → FIXED cd196fb; per-IP trust proxy → OPEN (B20/infra)
phrases_result: non-authoritative in text, arguments and tool output (measured by tests)
